prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Desktop Companion", "Select companion personality and visual style"]
1: ["How to Interact with Your New Pet", "Right-click pet anytime for main settings & companion commands", "Click and drag to position your pet anywhere on screen"]
2: ["Instant Pet Preview", "Verify how your photo converts into a desktop companion", "Select your photo"]
3: ["Save Your Companion to Account", "Linking your account ensures your pet is synced and safe from unexpected resets."]
4: ["Sign in with your primary email to sync pet memory and prevent accidental profile resets."]
5: ["Bringing Your Pet to Life", "Building 3D pet models and animations..."]
6: ["We will pop up a desktop notification as soon as your pet is ready to spawn!"]
7: ["Select Your Setup Journey", "Express Setup: Quick preset pet companion (2 mins)", "Custom Creation: Unique pet from your photo (5 mins)"]
8: ["Your Pet is Ready to Spawn!", "Click Finish to launch your pet onto your screen overlay. Check system tray permissions if pet window does not immediately appear."]
9: ["Begin Your Companion Journey", "Includes Free Starter Accessories & Toys"]
